result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major missing/broken image in the restaurant card and a minor layout issue with truncated text.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant card displays a generic placeholder image icon instead of an actual restaurant image, indicating the image failed to load or is missing
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image is properly hosted, has correct image path/URL, and implement a proper image loading error handler or fallback image

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' card in the 'Fastest near you' section appears to be cut off on the right edge, with the full restaurant name not fully visible
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card width, padding, or container size to ensure all restaurant names are fully visible without truncation, or implement proper text wrapping
